description: Registered suppressions. Every live suppression directive (oxlint, eslint, ts-expect-error, ts-ignore, ts-nocheck) must match an entry by file and directive, and every entry needs a live suppression. An entry names its scope, reason, native alternatives examined, owner, versions and retirement trigger.

exceptions.reason: The Browser service adapts Playwright, whose API returns Promises. Each call is wrapped once, in `inPage`, as `Effect.tryPromise({ try: () => page.method(...) })`; typescript/promise-function-async wants those arrow functions to be `async`, and its autofix then adds `await` and trips eslint/require-await and effecttsgo/async-function.
nativeAlternativesExamined: Effect.tryPromise and Effect.promise take a thunk that returns the Promise; they have no overload that takes a method and its arguments.
Making the thunks async: async-function is an Effect diagnostic at error severity and require-await rejects an async function that only returns the Promise.
An Effect-native browser driver: none in the installed effect 4.0.6 or @effect/platform-node 4.0.6.
exceptions.retirementTrigger: An Effect-native browser driver ships in the installed Effect packages, or the lint preset stops flagging thunks passed straight to Effect.tryPromise.
